name: q-key-opens-quick-settings-and-escape-closes-it
description: The Quick settings panel is reachable and dismissible from the keyboard alone: Q opens it and Escape closes it again without closing or pausing playback.

steps.note: Focus the actual Quick player window before sending the keyboard shortcut.
The Quick controller maps Q to the settings menu request; no pointer is used.

steps.name: objectVisible
steps.note: Q must open the real PlayerSettings scene panel before Escape is sent.
Escape dismisses the actual Quick menu stack without closing the player window.

assertions.note: The PlayerSettings scene panel is hidden after Escape.
The controller observes that the Quick menu stack has closed.
The window remains visible, so the key dismissed the menu rather than exiting playback.
And the core never stopped. Read from mpv itself rather than from the Qt cache written alongside it, so a build that muted the overlay by pausing fails here instead of passing as a clean dismiss.
